output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user, which can be exploited to grant unfair advantages to specific users.
The transferFrom function does not check if the subtraction of the transferred amount from the allowance overflows, allowing users to transfer more tokens than an owner has in allowance.
The burnFrom function does not check if the subtraction of the burned amount from the balance of the target address overflows, allowing users to burn more tokens than an owner has in allowance.
The transfer function does not check if the subtraction of the transferred amount from the balance of the sender overflows, allowing users to transfer more tokens than they have.
The sell function does not check if the subtraction of the amount to sell from the contract's balance overflows, allowing users to sell more tokens than the contract has.
